technical.summary: Extreme overbought conditions across RSI, Stochastic, and Williams %R with bullish structure but weak trend confirmation (ADX 20.8), no momentum crossovers, and deteriorating short-term momentum (RSI-9 falling) create high reversal risk despite price strength above key moving averages.

fundamental.summary: FE shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 70 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional activity with small-amount purchases from junior members; market fear (41 score) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (234) indicates extreme market stress, and utilities face credit spread pressure in tightening environment; earnings in 70 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price holds above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and OBV rising, supported by fear-zone contrarian opportunity (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve) that historically precedes reversals.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought RSI (9 & 14) without rising momentum, weak ADX trend confirmation (20.8), deteriorating short-term RSI-9, zero fundamental support, high earnings risk in 70 days, and macro crisis conditions (inverted curve, VIX 234) create severe reversal risk despite technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Not recommended. Extreme overbought conditions without momentum confirmation and zero fundamental support create unfavorable risk/reward despite contrarian fear-zone opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 234 crisis levels) combined with deteriorating short-term momentum (RSI-9 falling) and earnings event risk in 70 days create high probability of sharp reversal from current overbought extreme.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish outlook
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding FE with 64 existing Utilities positions (16% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure further reduce conviction for new entry.
